sloka: उवाच रामो धर्मात्मा पुनरप्यर्थकोविदः ।अग्रे यातु बलस्य अस्य नीलो मार्गम् अवेक्षितुम् ॥६-४-९॥।।
transliteration: uvāca rāmo dharmātmā punarapyarthakovidaḥ ।agre yātu balasya asya nīlo mārgam avekṣitum ॥6-4-9॥।।

translations.english: "Let Nila go leading in front with his courageous and hundred thousand army looking at the way (said Rama)".
